provenance.source: LGD / BharatMaps, via ramSeraph and DataMeet
provenance.boundaryVintage: Upstream snapshot date not established; 36-unit post-2020 administrative roster verified.
provenance.projection: Lambert conformal conic, parallels 12°N/35°N, origin 24°N, central meridian 80°E.
provenance.transformation: Projected to 640×720 SVG; topology-preserving per-feature simplification at 0.18 SVG units; coordinates rounded to 0.01; all polygon components retained; labels at largest-part pole of inaccessibility.
provenance.boundaryScope: Preserves upstream LGD/BharatMaps boundary claims, including disputed areas. Illustrative administrative coverage; not a survey or adjudication of territorial status. No historical record is reassigned using this geometry.
